lang.label: Language
meta.title: Kekal: a warranty that outlives the shop
meta.description: Kekal holds a shop's warranty money on Solana. If the shop stops answering a claim, the buyer is paid. If the shop goes silent, every holder is paid.
meta.ogAlt: Kekal: a warranty that outlives the shop. Three rules beside a sample warranty card showing a 25.00 kUSD reserve and a copper stamp marked Paid because the shop went silent.
home.lede: The shop's promise to install and service what it sold, backed by money it cannot take back while your warranty runs.
home.rule.silent: Shop silent on your claim: you are paid.
home.rule.gone: Shop goes quiet for good: every holder is paid.
home.rule.expired: Warranty ends: the reserve goes back to the shop.
card.title: Warranty card
card.sample.note: Sample card. The live demo issues a real one to your browser.
card.sample.notePending: Sample card. Real cards are issued once the program is on the network.

home.title: A warranty that outlives the shop
warranty.shopSilent: The shop went silent on {date}. Every card it issued is paid from its reserve.
warranty.activatedOn: Activated on a buyer's phone on {date}.
warranty.notActivated: Not activated yet. Until the first scan, the shop that printed this card can still act on it.
next.settleUnanswered: If the shop does not answer by {time}, the reserve is paid to the card holder.
next.closeStale: If nobody takes this further by {time}, the claim closes and the warranty carries on.
next.settleStaleDispute: If the arbiter does not decide by {time}, the reserve is paid to the card holder.
next.declareDormant: The shop must check in by {time}. If it does not, it is marked silent and every holder is paid.
next.claimOrphan: The shop went silent, so the reserve can be paid to the card holder now.
next.releaseExpired: On {time} this warranty ends and the reserve goes back to the shop.
terms.heading: The shop's promise
terms.match: This text matches the fingerprint recorded when the warranty was issued.
terms.mismatch: This text does not match the fingerprint recorded when the warranty was issued. Ask the shop for the original terms.
terms.missing: The terms text is not kept on this site. Its fingerprint is in the technical details; ask the shop for the text.
timeline.heading: What has happened
event.HolderTransferred: Card moved to a new phone
event.ReservePaid: Reserve paid to the card holder
event.WarrantyReleased: Warranty ended, reserve returned to the shop
tech.intro: Kekal runs on the Solana blockchain (devnet). The card is a bearer key, not a wallet you sign up for; the reserve is a kUSD token held by the Kekal program until it is paid out or returned.
missing.bad_address.title: That is not a warranty address
missing.bad_address.body: Check the link, or type the address printed under the code on the card.
missing.not_found.title: No warranty at this address
missing.not_found.body: Nothing Kekal issued lives here. The card may belong to a different network, or the address has a typo.
missing.network.title: We could not reach the network
missing.network.body: Your warranty is not affected: the reserve stays locked whether or not this page loads. Try again in a minute.
panel.readOnly: Read-only view. To act on this warranty, open the link from the card itself.
panel.unactivated: This card is not activated yet. Activating moves it to this phone: after that, the printed code no longer controls the warranty.
panel.taken: This card was already activated on another phone. If that was not you, take the card back to the shop.
panel.saveCard: Save this link now. It is your card from here on; anyone with it can act on the warranty.
panel.confirm: The shop fixed it: close the claim
panel.escalate: Not fixed: send to the arbiter
settle.settleUnanswered.body: The shop did not answer in time. Anyone may now pay the card holder.
settle.settleStaleDispute.body: The arbiter did not decide in time. Anyone may now pay the card holder.
settle.claimOrphan.body: The shop went silent. Anyone may now pay the card holder.
settle.declareDormant.body: The shop missed its check-in. Anyone may now mark it silent, which lets every holder be paid.
settle.closeStale.body: The time to take this claim further has passed. Anyone may now close it.
settle.releaseExpired.body: This warranty has ended. Anyone may now return the reserve to the shop.
settle.releaseExpired.button: Return the reserve to the shop
claim.heading: Make a claim
claim.description: Describe it in a few words
claim.privacy: Only a fingerprint of this text is recorded publicly. Tell the shop the details too.
send.heading: Money paid to you
send.badAddress: That address is not valid. Copy it again from the app that will receive the money.
send.badAmount: Enter an amount above zero and no more than the balance.
error.rate_ip: Too many requests from this network in the last hour. Try again later.
error.rate_holder: This card has sent many requests in the last hour. Try again later.
error.rate_global: The site has reached today's limit of free requests. Try again tomorrow.
error.network: We could not reach the network. Nothing was sent; try again.
error.failed_on_chain: The step was refused, usually because someone else acted first. The page will show the latest state.
error.activation_pending: We could not confirm the activation yet. The new card key is kept on this phone: reload this page in a minute and it will show the new card link if the activation went through.
error.not_confirmed: Sent, but not confirmed yet. Reload the page in a minute to see if it went through.
error.relayer_unavailable: Actions are paused on this site right now. The warranty and its reserve are unaffected.
error.generic: Something went wrong and nothing was sent. Try again.
check.title: Check a warranty
check.lede: Paste the address or the link from a warranty card to see its reserve, deadline and history.
check.label: Warranty address or card link
check.bad: That does not look like a warranty address. It is a long code of letters and numbers.
check.keyNote: If you paste a card link, its private part stays on this device and the page opens read-only.
error.send_failed: The network refused this step, usually because it is not due yet by the network's clock or someone acted first. Wait a few seconds and try again.
demo.title: Watch a shop's promise get paid
demo.lede: No wallet and no sign-up. This page makes a card key in your browser, a demo shop issues you a real warranty on the test network, and you watch the reserve reach you when the shop goes quiet. Every step is a public transaction you can open.
demo.examplesLink: See finished examples of every path
demo.silent.title: The shop goes silent on your claim
demo.silent.lede: The demo shop issues you a card and never answers claims. File one, and when its answer window runs out the money the shop locked for you is paid to your card.
demo.silent.start: Get a card from the silent shop
demo.silent.claimHint: Your card is live. Tell the shop what went wrong; only a fingerprint of your words is recorded.
demo.closed.title: The shop closes
demo.closed.lede: A brand-new shop issues you a card, then stops checking in, as a shop that shuts its doors would. Once it misses its check-in, anyone can mark it silent and every card it issued is paid.
demo.closed.start: Get a card from a shop about to close
demo.wait.settleUnanswered: The shop has {left} left to answer. It will not.
demo.wait.declareDormant: The shop's next check-in is due in {left}. It will not come.
demo.wait.claimOrphan: The card holder can be paid in {left}.
demo.wait.closeStale: This claim can be closed in {left}.
demo.wait.settleStaleDispute: The arbiter has {left} left to decide.
demo.why.WarrantyIssued: The shop set money aside for this card. It cannot take it back while the warranty runs.
demo.why.HolderTransferred: The card now answers to a key only this phone holds.
demo.why.ClaimFiled: Your claim is on record with the time it was filed. The shop's answer window starts now.
demo.why.ClaimResponded: The shop answered, and the answer is on record.
demo.why.ShopDeclaredDormant: The shop missed its check-in, so it is marked silent. No new cards, and every holder can be paid.
demo.why.ReservePaid: The reserve moved to the card holder. Nobody had to approve it, and the keeper or any visitor could send it.
examples.title: Every path, already finished
examples.lede: Each path below ran from start to end on the test network. Open any step to see the public record.
examples.empty: The finished examples for this network are not recorded yet. The live demo works now.
examples.path.A.title: The shop fixes it
examples.path.A.body: A claim is filed, the shop accepts and repairs, and the buyer confirms. The reserve stays locked for the rest of the warranty.
examples.path.B.title: The shop goes silent on a claim
examples.path.B.body: A claim is filed and the shop never answers. When the answer window ends, anyone sends the payout and the reserve goes to the buyer.
examples.path.C.title: The shop closes
examples.path.C.body: The shop stops checking in. Anyone marks it silent, then the buyer is paid without filing anything.
examples.path.D.title: The warranty ends quietly
examples.path.D.body: Nothing went wrong. When the warranty ends, the reserve goes back to the shop.
examples.path.E.title: The shop says no, an arbiter decides
examples.path.E.body: The shop rejects a claim, the buyer escalates, and the arbiter the shop named rules for the buyer, who is paid.
examples.step.settle_unanswered: Paid: the shop did not answer
examples.step.release_expired: Warranty ended, reserve back to the shop
error.demo_unavailable: The demo is resting right now. The finished examples still show every path.
error.demo_shop_missing: The demo shop is not set up on this network yet. The finished examples still show every path.
card.print.scan: Scan with your phone camera to activate this card.
home.cta: Try the live demo: no wallet needed
home.stats.label: Live figures on {network}
wallet.why: Shops and arbiters sign with their own Solana wallet set to devnet (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack). The wallet pays the small network fee; Kekal never holds your wallet key.
wallet.none: No Solana wallet was found in this browser. Install one and switch it to devnet, or
wallet.tryDemo: try the demo without a wallet.
wallet.failed: The wallet did not connect. Open it, unlock it and try again.
kedai.title: Shop board
kedai.lede: Lock a reserve, issue printed warranty cards with a QR code, and answer claims before the window closes.
kedai.devnet: This runs on {network} with test money only.
kedai.sending: Waiting for your wallet, then for confirmation…
kedai.open.heading: Open your shop
kedai.open.body: Opening a shop records its claim windows: how long you have to answer a claim, to finish a repair, and how often you must show you are still open. They cannot change later, so every card you issue keeps the same rules.
kedai.open.noMint: No reserve currency is set up on this site yet, so shops cannot open here for now.
kedai.reserve.heading: Reserve
kedai.alive.heading: Still open
kedai.alive.silentAt: Without another check-in, anyone may mark the shop silent from {when}, and every card holder is paid.
kedai.claims.heading: Open claims
kedai.claim.reason: Note to the buyer (needed to reject)
kedai.issue.heading: Issue a card
kedai.issue.hint: Promise only what your shop does itself, such as installation and service. The manufacturer's warranty stays separate. The text is fingerprinted into the card, so it cannot change after issue.
kedai.card.heading: Card {id} is issued
kedai.card.qrAlt: QR code of the card link
kedai.card.keyWarning: Download or print the card now. Its key exists only in this tab and is gone when you leave. Until the buyer scans it, anyone holding the printed card can activate it.
kedai.card.pdf: PDF card (A6, English and Bahasa Melayu)
kedai.card.link: Card link (contains the key: give it only to the buyer)
kedai.card.termsNotKept: The card is valid, but its promise text was not saved on this site, so the warranty page cannot show it.
kedai.card.fileFailed: The file could not be made in this browser. Copy the card link instead.
kedai.cards.heading: Cards issued ({n})
kedai.error.wallet_declined: The wallet did not sign. Nothing was sent.
kedai.error.wallet_no_account: The wallet shared no account. Unlock it and connect again.
kedai.error.network: We could not reach the network. Nothing was sent; try again.
kedai.error.send_failed: The network refused this step. Check that your wallet holds devnet SOL for the fee and enough of the reserve currency, then try again.
kedai.error.failed_on_chain: The step was refused by the program, for example a reserve above your free balance or a window already closed. The board shows the latest state.
kedai.error.not_confirmed: Sent, but not confirmed yet. The board will show it once it lands.
kedai.error.rate_ip: Too many requests from this network in the last hour. Try again later.
kedai.error.generic: Something went wrong and nothing was sent. Try again.
timbang.title: Arbiter board
timbang.lede: Claims a shop rejected and the buyer escalated. Read both sides on the card page, then rule. If no ruling comes in time, the buyer can be paid without one.
timbang.none: No disputes are waiting for this wallet.
timbang.stale: The buyer can be paid without a ruling from {when}.
notice.notDeployed: The program is not on {network} yet. Until it is, nothing can be sent and the live demo is closed; the finished examples show every path.
demo.closed.notDeployed.title: The live demo opens when the program is on {network}
demo.closed.notDeployed.body: It will issue you a real card on the test network and pay it out when the shop goes quiet. Until then, the finished examples walk through every path one step at a time.
error.program_not_deployed: The program is not on the network yet, so this cannot be sent. The finished examples still show every path.
